# Aarhus Universitetshospital

Aarhus Universitetshospital is a Danish university hospital named in the ADHD-databasen documentation as an affiliation of one or more members of the database's steering group, specifically through its psychiatric department, "Psykiatrien," under Region Midtjylland [^src1]. The ADHD-databasen is a Danish health database monitoring the quality of diagnosis and treatment of ADHD in children and adolescents under 18 years of age, and its steering group draws members — senior physicians, specialists, psychologists, nurses, epidemiologists, and relative/patient representatives — from institutions across Denmark, including Aarhus Universitetshospital.

The available data on Aarhus Universitetshospital is limited to a single mention identifying its psychiatric department as a steering-group affiliation within Region Midtjylland [^src1]. No further relationships, claims, or timeline events involving this entity are present in the corpus.
